blocks.tamil_translation: there is this virtue,' said the Prophet ﷺ. Hazrat Abu Umamah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ further said: “Straighten your rows, and align shoulders with shoulders; in the work of straightening the rows “be gentle towards your brothers, and fill the gaps between the rows, because Shaytan enters (into the gaps of the rows) like a young lamb”.

blocks.text: Explanation:- “Being gentle towards one's brothers' means: if someone, in order to straighten the row, puts his hand on your shoulder and tells you to move forward or back, comply with him.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: خَيْرُ صُفُوفِ الرِّجَالِ أَوَّلُهَا، وَشَرُّهَا آخِرُهَا، وَخَيْرُ صُفُوفِ النِّسَاءِ آخِرُهَا، وَشَرُّهَا أَوَّلُهَا.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Among the rows of men, the most reward is received in the first row, and among the rows of men the least reward is received by those in the last row. Among the rows of women, the most reward is received in the last row, and among the rows of women the least reward is received by the one in the first row.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ ﵄ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ يَتَخَلَّلُ الصَّفَّ مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ إِلَي نَاحِيَةٍ، يَمْسَحُ صُدُورَنَا وَمَنَاكِبَنَا وَيَقُولُ: لَا تَخْتَلِفُوا فَتَخْتَلِفَ قُلُوبُكُمْ وَكَانَ يَقُولُ: إِنَّ اللهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَي الصُّفُوفِ اْلأُوَلِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد، باب تسوية الصفوف، رقم:٦٦٤
